title: anthyllis rubra
intro: Anthyllis rubra, commonly known as kidney vetch, is a flowering plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This perennial herb has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as a diuretic to help alleviate kidney issues. The therapeutic actions of kidney vetch are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that have anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents are believed to contribute to its ability to support kidney function, lower blood pressure, and promote wound healing.
